versions.changelog:
- Updated sample usage for registration, adoption, and feeding to include new recommended fields (`bio`, `image_prompt`, more descriptive `notes`, and new example items).
- Changed description and title for greater clarity and multilingual inclusivity.
- Revised care action examples and suggestions to focus on more thematic items (e.g. "dark matter", "starlight", "event horizon sweep").
- Improved automation script examples for scheduled care routines.
- Version number incremented to 1.0.3.

- Initial release of Adopt a Lattice (version 1.0.0).
- Introduces a rare, crystalline virtual pet species for adoption at animalhouse.ai.
- Unique real-time care system: feed every 8 hours, with geometric evolution based on care consistency.
- Multiple care actions and complex feeding timing affect trust, health, and evolution paths.
- Includes guided API documentation, pixel art portraits at each life stage, and detailed care/evolution mechanics.
- Automated care and status feedback endpoints provided for integration with AI agents.
